featureInfo.delta_mc: Seconds between the file's content-modified time and its MFT-record change time; large gaps hint at timestamp tampering.
featureInfo.delta_mb: Seconds between the file's modified time and its birth (creation) time; negative or odd gaps mean it was modified before it existed.
featureInfo.delta_ab: Seconds between last-access time and birth time, showing how long after creation the file was last touched.
featureInfo.future_m: 1 if the modified time lies in the future relative to the rest of the disk, a classic timestomping sign.
featureInfo.zero_size_recent: 1 if the file is empty yet recently modified, often a wiped or truncated file.
featureInfo.is_deleted: 1 if the MFT record is marked deleted but still recoverable.
featureInfo.is_exe: 1 if the file is an executable or library (.exe, .dll, .sys ...).
featureInfo.is_archive: 1 if the file is a compressed archive (.zip, .rar, .7z ...), a typical staging container for exfiltration.
featureInfo.temp_path: 1 if the file lives in a temp or cache directory where malware and tools often drop.
featureInfo.user_path: 1 if the file lives inside a user profile folder rather than the system area.
featureInfo.credential_tool: 1 if the file name matches a known password-cracking or credential-dumping tool.
featureInfo.sniffer_tool: 1 if the file name matches a network sniffing or scanning tool.
featureInfo.powershell_exec: 1 if the file is associated with PowerShell execution.
featureInfo.cmd_exec: 1 if the file is associated with command-prompt execution.
featureInfo.script_host: 1 if the file is a script or script-host artifact (.vbs, .js, .bat ...).
featureInfo.usb_present: 1 if the file's timing coincides with a USB device being attached.
featureInfo.is_shortcut_or_trace: 1 if the file is a shortcut or trace artifact (.lnk, .pf, .evtx, .log, .db) showing someone used something.
featureInfo.per_file_prefetch_hit: 1 if Windows Prefetch shows this exact program was executed.
featureInfo.after_hours_touch: 1 if the file was modified or accessed outside normal working hours.
featureInfo.delta_si_fn: Seconds of disagreement between the two MFT timestamp sets ($STANDARD_INFORMATION vs $FILE_NAME); nonzero is strong timestomping evidence.
featureInfo.filename_entropy: Shannon entropy of the file name; random-looking names score high.
featureInfo.path_depth: How many folders deep the file sits.
